cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the children the trip is postponed for bus repairs. Keep the message simple so they don't panic about Mr Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lead with 'Mr Patel is fine'. Then 'the bus needs repairs'. Please use that order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add 'parked' before 'bus'. Use the same wording for parents and children; don't improvise a second account on the phone.

reason: Keep factual reassurance and parked qualifier; professional editing shapes one protective account without asserting a different cause.
